image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of two whole green cucumbers and one sliced cucumber end resting on a speckled white surface. The cucumbers have a bumpy, textured skin with visible water droplets. The sliced section reveals the internal seed structure.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rind is distinctly bumpy and textured with raised spines/warts, not smooth as described in this specific checkpoint.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Small raised bumps or spines on surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Clearly visible raised tubercles/spines across the skin surface.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Some water droplets appear slightly 'painted on' or lack perfect refractive clarity, blending softly into the skin texture rather than sitting sharply on top. Minor AI smoothing effect.

The cut surface of the left cucumber slice looks somewhat compressed and lacks the crisp, clean edge of a real knife cut. The internal seed structure is slightly mushy/indistinct compared to the sharpness of the skin.
